title: Flying Delight Modpack
description: Flying delight is a modpack that I envision on what if Minecraft modpack remained the way they are from 2010.
body:
![Flying Delight Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac75671e2dff86612c045fb61b98d3758ec558f5_0.webp)

## Oh so this is where I should have written the description.

Alright, I am kinda dumb as rocks it seems. But let's focus on that later.

Welcome to Flying Delight Modpack, a modpack that tries to capture technology of old Minecraft but also focus on exploration, building, and fighting bosses.

I've always wanted to create a modpack, so this is my first time uploading it here so not only can my friends download it, but maybe strangers can enjoy it aswell.

I take criticsm with open arms and any suggestion with open ears, thank you a lot.
